assets.caption: FIGURE 8 PROBABILITY DISTRIBUTION OF DROPLETS AND THEIR DEPOSITION DUE TO TURBULENT DIFFUSION, GRAVITY AND CENTRIFUGAL FORCE WHEN ENTERING THE SLUG CATCHER
assets.notes: Dual-axis chart. Left Y-axis: Fraction of Droplets depositing (%). Right Y-axis: Probability density / droplet diameter ratio (%). X-axis: Assumed Droplet Size (micrometer). Annotations: Vg = 3 m/s; Downcomer inclination = 45 degrees; Downcomer/riser diameter ratio = 0.75; CFD-code K-epsilon model; 50,000 grid cells; 10,000 iterations; 81 injection points; 100 realisations/pt. Deposition label: deposition (viscous layer < stopping distance). Legend: turbulence + gravity + bend; density of size (Katoaka); gravity; turbulence + gravity.
